correctness.rationale: The alternating positive positions of 10101 require three windows, giving the universal upper bound. On four points let a,b,c be the successive differences and L,R the outer zero-gap lengths. The two alternating traces force a+b,b+c>=r+1 and L+a,R+c>=r. Those spans exclude any three queries in one window, so 1111 must split 2+2 and a,c<=r-1. Now 0000 can use only the gaps L,b-1,R: two must have length at least r or one must have length at least 2r. The two-gap cases give n>=3r+3, and the single-gap cases give n>=4r+2>3r+3. At equality the outer-outer case forces (L,a,b,c,R)=(r,1,r,1,r). The outer-middle case forces (r,1,r+1,c,r-c), or its reflection. In 0110 the two positive queries cannot share a window (their distance is at least r), so the interval strictly between the two excluded exterior queries must fit both windows. Its length is r+1 in the first case and r+1+c in the second, eliminating the first and forcing c=r-1 in the second. The affine witness table realizes all 16 traces for the reflected candidate, including r=2 and placements with adjacent windows, and the same placements embed in any larger chain. Independently, enumerating slack compositions before, between and after the windows and projecting the resulting binary strings tested 184191 supports for 2<=r<=8 from n=2r+1 through n=3r+3 and recovered exactly the two critical supports at each onset.
residual_risks: The bounded search is corroboration, not the all-r argument. The proof uses exactly two length-r intervals and permits adjacency; it claims no complete VC dimension below onset or online rank.
